identity.description: A TinyRCT backdoor establishes a SoftEther VPN tunnel for C2 communication and performs credential dumping on a Linux host. Cortex should detect the process creation, network connection, and file access patterns associated with this activity.

techniques.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Unix Shell

expected_artifacts.description: Established VPN tunnel to C2 server

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: VPN Tunnel Process Creation
biocs.description: Detection of SoftEther process start for VPN tunneling
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = '/tmp/softether'

biocs.name: C2 Network Connection
biocs.description: Detection of outbound connection to C2 IP
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECT
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.100'

xql_queries.name: VPN Process Start Hunt
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = '/tmp/softether'
| fields actor_process_image_name, action_process_image_name, causality_actor_process_image_name

xql_queries.name: C2 Connection Hunt
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECT
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.100'
| fields dst_ip, dst_port, action_remote_ip
